subject_uz: Muborak obyektlarida 30 m3 li avtosisternalarda neft tashish xizmati (tonna-kilometr hisobida)

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat: neft va gaz kondensatini tonna-kilometr uchun belgilangan stavka boʻyicha toʻlov asosida tashish.
requirements.summary_en: Service: transport of oil and gas condensate paid per tonne-kilometre at a fixed rate.
requirements.quote: neft tashish xizmatlarini ko‘rsatish, tonna-kilometr uchun haq to‘lash asosida

requirements.summary_uz: Sisterna neft va neft xom ashyosini tashishga moʻljallangan, germetik, kalibrlangan va plombalash imkoniyatiga ega boʻlishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The tank must be designed for oil and crude, sealed, calibrated, and capable of being sealed with tamper seals.
requirements.quote: Sisterna neft va neft xom ashyolarini tashish uchun mo'ljallangan, germetik yopiladigan, kalibrlangan,

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir texnika birligi datchiklar va sunʼiy yoʻldosh (GPS) monitoringi tizimi bilan jihozlangan boʻlishi kerak (25 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Every vehicle must be fitted with sensors and satellite (GPS) monitoring (25 points).
requirements.quote: Har bir maxsus texnika birligi yuqori uskunaning ishlashini nazorat qiluvchi datchiklar va bort sun’iy yo‘ldosh monitoringi tizimi bilan jihozlangan bo‘lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Texnikani quyish punktlariga yetkazish muddati qancha qisqa boʻlsa, ball shuncha yuqori (10 kungacha 10 ball, 21-30 kunda 3 ball).
requirements.summary_en: The faster the fleet can be mobilised to the loading points, the more points (up to 10 days: 10 points; 21-30 days: 3 points).
requirements.quote: Safarbarlik muddati — shartnoma tuzilgan kundan boshlab texnikani quyish punktlariga yetkazib berish

requirements.summary_uz: Sisterna parkining ishlab chiqarilgan yili va texnik holati baholanadi (2020-yildan keyingi texnika uchun 15 ball, 2010-yildan keyingi uchun 10 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Fleet age and condition are scored (15 points for 2020 or later, 10 points for 2010 or later).
requirements.quote: Sisternalar parkidagi texnikalarning ishlab chiqarilgan yili va texnik holati

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha haydovchilar xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat hujjatlariga ega boʻlishi shart (25 ball).
requirements.summary_en: All drivers must hold permits to carry hazardous cargo (25 points).
requirements.quote: Barcha haydovchilarning xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat hujjatlari bilan ta’minlanganligi

requirements.summary_uz: Neft tashish tajribasi baholanadi: 3 yil va undan ortiq 15 ball, 2 yil va undan ortiq 10 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Oil-haulage experience is scored: 3 years or more 15 points, 2 years or more 10 points.
requirements.quote: Neft va neft mahsulotlarini tashish bo‘yicha 3 yil va undan ortiq tajribani tasdiqlovchi shartnomalar nusxalari

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash ikki bosqichda: A blok boʻyicha talablarga mos kelmasa diskvalifikatsiya; 70 balldan kam toʻplagan texnik taklif qabul qilinmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: Two-stage evaluation: failing the block A mandatory requirements means disqualification; a technical offer scoring under 70 points is rejected.
requirements.quote: 70 balldan kam to'plagan texnik taklif qabul qilinmaydi.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni cheklovchi jiddiy shart topilmadi.
reasons_en: No seriously restrictive condition was found in the document.

Neft tashish tajribasini tasdiqlovchi shartnomalar, dalolatnomalar va buyurtmachilar fikrlari
Davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtganlik guvohnomasi, ustav, bankrotlik boʻyicha maʼlumot

Buyurtmachining quyish punktlariga texnikani yetkazib berishni tasdiqlovchi kafolat xati
